LESSON: SELECTED CROP MANAGEMENT PRACTISES

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: AGRICULTURE
Strand: Food Production Processes
Topic 2.2: Selected Crop Management Practises

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Selected Crop Management Practises. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How can we carry out management practises in crop production?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. explain management practises carried out on crops

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. explain management practises carried out on crops
   In simple words: practise until you can explain management practises carried out on crops. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Selected Crop Management Practises using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Selected Crop Management Practises in the examples.
2. Explain Selected Crop Management Practises to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Selected Crop Management Practises.
4. Show that you can: explain management practises carried out on crops

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Selected Crop Management Practises using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Selected Crop Management Practises important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. explain management practises carried out on crops

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
